professional_registration_requirements.SACNASP: Statutory registration mandatory for all geoscientists practicing in South Africa under the Natural Scientific Professions Act. Required for Competent Person sign-off on SAMREC-compliant reports.
professional_registration_requirements.ECSA: Statutory registration required for engineers performing identified engineering work under the Engineering Profession Act 46 of 2000. Required for rock and geotechnical engineers.
professional_registration_requirements.GSSA_SAIMM_membership: Professional membership of the Geological Society of South Africa (GSSA) or the Southern African Institute of Mining and Metallurgy (SAIMM) is recognised as qualifying a practitioner as a Competent Person under SAMREC.
professional_registration_requirements.CIDB_grading: CIDB (Construction Industry Development Board) grading applies primarily to construction contractors, not professional consulting services. However, consulting firms contracted by CIDB-regulated projects may need to demonstrate alignment with grading requirements. Professional service providers (geology, geotechnics) typically register under the EP (Engineering and Professional) category.
professional_registration_requirements.BBBEE: Broad-Based Black Economic Empowerment compliance scoring is a standard evaluation criterion in government and SOE tenders, typically weighted under the Preferential Procurement Policy Framework Act (PPPFA).
professional_registration_requirements.CSD_registration: All suppliers to government must be registered on the Central Supplier Database (csd.gov.za).

regulatory_watchlist.body_name: Department of Mineral Resources and Energy (DMRE)
regulatory_watchlist.what_they_regulate: All aspects of mineral prospecting, exploration, mining rights, resource and reserve reporting, mine health oversight, and petroleum resources in South Africa
key_compliance_obligations: Compliance with the Mineral and Petroleum Resources Development Act (MPRDA) No. 28 of 2002 for all resource reporting and rights applications
Submission of Mineral Resource and Reserve statements that are SAMREC-compliant, signed off by a registered Competent Person
SAMRAD online portal is the sole legal channel for prospecting and mining right applications
Social and Labour Plan (SLP) obligations for mining rights holders
Environmental authorisation and Environmental Management Plan (EMP) submission
regulatory_watchlist.monitor_at: https://www.dmre.gov.za — Publications, Regulations and Mineral Regulation Overview sections

regulatory_watchlist.body_name: SAMCODES Standing Committee (SSC) — SAMREC and SAMVAL
regulatory_watchlist.what_they_regulate: The South African Code for the Reporting of Exploration Results, Mineral Resources and Mineral Reserves (SAMREC) and the South African Code for the Valuation of Mineral Assets (SAMVAL); sets minimum standards for public and JSE-mandated reporting
key_compliance_obligations: All public reports of Exploration Results, Mineral Resources and Mineral Reserves must conform to SAMREC
Mineral asset valuations for JSE disclosure must conform to SAMVAL
Reports must be signed by a Competent Person registered with SACNASP, ECSA, GSSA or SAIMM
CRIRSCO alignment required for international cross-listing (ASX, TSX, etc.)
regulatory_watchlist.monitor_at: https://www.samcode.co.za — Code revisions, guidelines and FAQs

regulatory_watchlist.body_name: South African Council for Natural Scientific Professions (SACNASP)
regulatory_watchlist.what_they_regulate: Statutory registration and regulation of natural scientists (geologists, geohydrologists, environmental scientists) practicing in South Africa under the Natural Scientific Professions Act 27 of 2003
key_compliance_obligations: All geologists and geoscientists employed by or contracting for Salaria must be registered with SACNASP
It is illegal to practice geology in South Africa without SACNASP registration
Continuing Professional Development (CPD) points required for annual renewal
Competent Person designation under SAMREC requires SACNASP registration
regulatory_watchlist.monitor_at: https://www.sacnasp.org.za — Register, CPD requirements, disciplinary notices

regulatory_watchlist.what_they_regulate: Statutory registration of professional engineers and technologists under the Engineering Profession Act 46 of 2000; covers rock engineers, geotechnical engineers and mining engineers
key_compliance_obligations: Rock engineers and geotechnical engineers must be registered with ECSA as Professional Engineers (Pr Eng) to perform identified engineering work
Non-compliance is illegal under the Engineering Profession Act
CPD obligations for registered professionals
Required for sign-off on engineering designs, rock engineering codes of practice for mines
regulatory_watchlist.monitor_at: https://www.ecsa.co.za — Registration categories, CPD, disciplinary decisions

regulatory_watchlist.body_name: Mine Health and Safety Inspectorate (MHSI) — within DMRE
regulatory_watchlist.what_they_regulate: Mine health and safety compliance under the Mine Health and Safety Act (MHSA) No. 29 of 1996 and its regulations; particularly relevant to rock engineering and geotechnical work at active mines
key_compliance_obligations: All rock engineering and geotechnical work conducted at operating mines must comply with the MHSA
Mines must have an appointed Rock Engineering Manager (registered Pr Eng or Pr Sci Nat) where required by regulations
Codes of Practice (CoP) for seismic risk management, slope stability, and support design must be maintained and submitted to MHSI
MHSI inspectors can suspend mine operations for non-compliance; administrative fines up to ZAR 1 million per offence
Mine Health and Safety Amendment Bill (2024) introduces updated requirements — monitor for enactment
regulatory_watchlist.monitor_at: https://www.mhsc.org.za — Legislation section; https://www.dmre.gov.za — Mine Health and Safety Act and Regulations

key_terminology.full_form: South African Code for the Reporting of Exploration Results, Mineral Resources and Mineral Reserves

key_terminology.full_form: South African Code for the Valuation of Mineral Assets
key_terminology.use_in_classification: Companion to SAMREC for mineral asset valuation; often referenced in M&A and JSE listing contexts

key_terminology.full_form: South African Code for the Reporting of Oil and Gas Resources
key_terminology.use_in_classification: Oil and gas equivalent of SAMREC; relevant if Salaria expands into petroleum resource reporting

key_terminology.full_form: Committee for Mineral Reserves International Reporting Standards
key_terminology.use_in_classification: International umbrella body for SAMREC, JORC, NI 43-101 etc.; cross-listing requirements referenced here
